purpose: Teach: 邦訳/自由民主党/自由党/角川書店/講じる/可用性/外為/用水

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外作品の邦訳出版を企画しろ
lines.en: I want you to plan a Japanese translation and publication deal for overseas works.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Lean into the weight of the command. Pause after the opening clause. No room for negotiation. Confident authority that doesn't need to raise volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。自由民主党の議員との懇談を予定しております
lines.en: Yes, understood. We have a meeting scheduled with a Diet member from the LDP.
lines.style: Formal, clipped acknowledgment. Slight bow in the voice on the opening word. Professional distance. Reporting back with precision, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、自由党の動向にも注意しろ
lines.en: And keep watch on the Liberal Party's movements as well.
lines.style: Crisp follow-up, a secondary instruction. Firm but not harsh. The addition lands as addendum—important but expected.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。角川書店の編集者と協力します
lines.en: Understood. I'm coordinating with an editor at Kadokawa Publishing.
lines.style: Quick confirmation. Eager to demonstrate readiness. Flat delivery—showing he's already moving on the task. Efficient, not urgent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約改善策を講じる時期だ
lines.en: It's time we implement contract improvement measures.
lines.style: Measured pronouncement. Finality on the word 'time.' Hiroshi isn't asking, he's declaring readiness to act. Slight emphasis on the decision itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバーの可用性を強化しました
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already upgraded our server redundancy and capacity.
lines.style: Rapid-fire answer showing initiative. Slight pride in having already done the work. Keep pace tight. Confidence without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、外為の動向を毎日確認しろ
lines.en: Make sure you check foreign exchange movements every single day.
lines.style: Specific, demanding instruction. Emphasis on 'every single day'—the routine matters here. Calm but non-negotiable. The kind of order that sticks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の用水確保を進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're making progress on securing water supply for the factory.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment, slightly slower cadence. Wrapping up the exchange. Professional and steady. The end of a meeting—he's moving to execute.
